text: Can food be three thousand years old? Yes, it can! Scientists in Egypt found old pots in a tomb. There was honey in the pots. The honey was three thousand years old. And it was good to eat!
Why does honey never go bad? Honey has got very little water. Bacteria can't live without water. Honey is also very sweet. So it stays fresh for a very long time.
Bees make honey from flowers. One bee makes only a little honey. So a spoon of honey is hard work. Next time you eat honey, remember the old tomb!

text: Dana can't see the path. There is snow everywhere. It is cold and the sun is going down. Her dog Bars is with her. “Where is the village?” she says.

An old man opens the door. He has got hot tea. “Your dog is clever,” he says. “This is the only house on the mountain.” Dana hugs Bars. Dogs can smell a house from far away.

text: The first man in space went up from Kazakhstan. His name was Yuri Gagarin. The date was 12 April 1961. The place was Baikonur, in the Kazakh steppe.
The name of the rocket was Vostok. Gagarin was in space for 108 minutes. He saw the Earth from above. “The Earth is blue,” he said. Then he was back at home. He was a hero.
Today Baikonur is still a big space centre. Rockets go up from there every year. People from many countries go to space. They go from the steppe of Kazakhstan. And the first was Gagarin, in 1961.

text: There is a small helicopter on Mars. Its name is Ingenuity. It is very small — only 1.8 kilograms. On 19 April 2021 it went up. It was the first flight on another planet.
Flying on Mars is very hard. The air on Mars is very thin. So the helicopter has got very fast blades. It can fly for only a few minutes. It can't fly for a long time.

People made Ingenuity for five flights. But it made 72 flights! It found the best way for the robot Perseverance. In January 2024 the helicopter had an accident. Now it stands on Mars and doesn't fly. But it made history.

text: Some birds fly and don't stop for ten months! The bird is the common swift. It is small, dark and very fast. It eats in the air. It drinks in the air. It even sleeps in the air.

How can a bird sleep and fly? Scientists think the swift sleeps for short moments. It goes very high in the evening. Then it comes down slowly. One part of its brain sleeps. The other part does not sleep.
The swift only stops to have babies. Its nest is under a roof. The babies learn to fly. Then the family goes back into the sky. Look up in summer. Maybe a swift is over your head now.

text: In 2008 scientists went into a cave in Armenia. It was dark and cold. In the ground they found a shoe. It was a small leather shoe with a string. It was 5,500 years old!

text: The first website in the world is still online. It is very simple. There are no pictures, no colours, no videos. Only black text and blue links. And it is very important.

Tim Berners-Lee from England made it in 1991. His job was at CERN in Switzerland. Scientists there had a problem. They had a lot of information on many computers. Tim had an idea: links between all the pages.

The idea was the World Wide Web. It is the “www” in every address. Tim's idea was free for everybody. He said: “This is for the whole world.” Today there are more than a billion websites. And the first was one page of text.
